conbody.p: Use the cargo area cover to hide items stored in the cargo area. You can also place lightweight items on top.

li.p: If the cargo area cover is connected to the tailgate, the cover lifts with the tailgate when opening the tailgate.
If you do not want the cargo area cover to lift with the tailgate, disconnect the strap from the strap holder of the tailgate.

section.title: Removing cargo area cover
section.p: To remove the cargo area cover:

li.p: Disconnect the strap from the strap holder of the tailgate.
Lift the cover diagonally and pull it out.

section.p: To reinstall, follow the reverse order.

li.p: When the cargo area cover is removed, you can secure the cover to the rear seatback not to distract you while driving.
Since the cargo area cover also lifts when opening the tailgate, move the items placed on top of the cover to a safe place so they do not fall.
Do not put excessive pressure or weight on the cargo area cover. The cargo area cover may be damaged.
Open the tailgate and remove the cover according to “Removing cargo area cover”.
Insert the cargo area cover by laying it down and guiding it into the inner mounting points.
Be careful not to get the cover caught in the cargo.
Secure the cargo area cover hooks to the inner mounting points by applying slight pressure.
Raise the cargo area cover to an angle of approximately 45° and push it gently until it engages with the push bar and is securely fastened.
To remove the cargo area cover, press the push bar to release the lock, then remove it in the reverse order of installation.

note.p: When securing cover, be careful not to get the cover caught on the upper fixing part. The cargo area cover may be damaged.
